what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 321 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in Sweden, 1.1% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
It also records armed conflicts over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 1598 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 28727, at the end of 2002; the main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 2003.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
